name: A back-dated owner's supplementary charge owes no fee for days before it existed
title: SC-13-01-14 A back-dated owner's supplementary charge owes no fee for days before it existed
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F3
When the manager assigns an owner to unit "A-3" effective "2026-10-11" on "2026-11-19"
Then the supplementary charge of 1016.13 has period due date "2026-10-10" and effective due date "2026-11-19"
And its late fee is 0.00 at creation and 16.94 on "2026-11-29"
